previous_contract_not_misrepresented: The champion satisfied the two-record-loss objective. The successor explicitly expands the engineering requirement to three losses.
dominant_failure: Removing circuits 461,471,476 eliminates nearly all sensitivity to the Y gate's z-axis error; this is the worst triple in 2616 of 3000 operating points. A secondary cluster removes X_z sensitivity.
target_rationale: A usable design must stay within a fourfold overall and fivefold per-regime local variance-risk budget relative to the champion's intact information. Merely halving the enormous singular-design loss risk would not meet a meaningful characterization objective.
new_hidden_sampling: 100 independent draws per disclosed regime, unchanged forward model and sampler; not the prior private fitting ensemble.
